model.title: Clergy Act
model.meta: Finance Committee, Ways and Means Committee · Rep. Vince Fong (R-CA)

summary.text: The bill would create a two-year period during which members of the clergy and Christian Science practitioners could revoke their previous exemption from Social Security and Medicare taxes, allowing them to gain retirement benefits they would otherwise forgo. It would also require the IRS to develop a plan to inform eligible individuals about this opportunity to change their status.
